# Restaurantji

> Restaurantji is a comprehensive restaurant discovery platform featuring menus, reviews, ratings, and locations across North America.

Restaurantji aggregates restaurant information including detailed menus, customer reviews, photo galleries, and dining options across multiple cuisines and cities. The platform serves diners seeking restaurant details, hours, reservations, and special dietary accommodations.

## Key Topics

- Restaurant Reviews
- Restaurant Directory
- Menu Information
- Restaurant Ratings
- Local Businesses
- Vegetarian Options
- Catering Services
- Mexican Cuisine
- Italian Restaurants
- Pet-Friendly Dining
- Meal Delivery
- Asian Cuisine
- Reservations
- Dietary Accommodations
- Restaurant Locations

## Core Platform

- [Restaurantji - Restaurant Menus, Reviews, Ratings and Locations](https://www.restaurantji.com): Homepage: browse restaurant menus, reviews, ratings, and locations across multiple cities
